assertions.source: sin(Im𝔙/πℏ) oscillation produces a zero of N_odd in the substrate window — the feature the RAW Im(ι₁₃) form (A3 probe) lacked

assertions.name: one_instanton_slope_far_below_A_prime
assertions.source: parameter-free one-instanton slope at its zero is ~4 orders below A′≈2.37; the 1/u³ lever cancels in the ratio and does NOT rescue it — a derived prefactor/ℏ-scaling is required (must not be fitted)

assertions.name: one_instanton_zero_not_pinned_to_qstar
assertions.source: the phase-zero q_z is ~0.009 from q₀≈q* (~1e6× the anchor gap) — the parameter-free form does not place the zero at q*

description: One-instanton magnitude test for the A_ω normalization map (OneInstantonNormalization.lean, PR #4246). Parameter-free (𝒜=1, P=1, ℏ=log q) test of N_odd = e^{-Re𝔙/πℏ}·sin(Im𝔙/πℏ) against the committed BarOddLadderShape (A′≈2.37, |N_odd|~2.5e-8 at anchors). HONEST RESULT (scope-a): the sin oscillation supplies the ZERO-CROSSING STRUCTURE (q_z≈1.1013) the raw Im(ι₁₃) form lacked, but parameter-free it does NOT reproduce N_odd quantitatively — slope at the zero ~4 orders below A′ (the 1/u³ lever CANCELS in the ratio, does not rescue it), zero ~0.009 off q*, prefactor ~100× too large near the anchors. The one-instanton is the structurally necessary ingredient but insufficient parameter-free; the closing prefactor/ℏ-scaling must be DERIVED not tuned. An earlier coincidental A′·u³ 'amplitude match' is RETRACTED. No fit; no c_k wired.
